name: ANANYA SHARMA
pullQuote: “MAC wasn't just another college club; it was our operational bootcamp. The discipline of managing 40-member teams and 3 AM pitch revisions prepared me for corporate strategy better than any case study ever could.”
fullLetter: Stepping into the secretariat role during the 2024-25 tenure taught me the delicate balance between creative freedom and ruthless administrative precision. We orchestrated the bi-annual Markopolis conclave across 18 Delhi University colleges with zero operational latency.
The network you build here is permanent. You learn to rely on your peers under high pressure, to negotiate under constraints, and to deliver polished campaigns when the spotlight is blinding.
My advice to juniors: don't wait for permission to innovate. Take ownership of your wing, obsess over the fine details of your decks, and leave the department stronger than you inherited it.
